$comment: Routing rules live here, not in code (component 10). Call sites ask for an
intent ('chat', 'agent', 'classify'); this file decides which provider and
model serve it. Changing routing is a config edit and a restart, not a deploy.
A profile that names a provider with no credentials configured is a startup
error, on purpose — silently falling back is how you end up paying cloud
rates for work you thought was running locally.
MODEL NAMES: check what your key can actually reach before assuming these
The adapter sends 'max_tokens'. OpenAI's reasoning models (o-series) require
'max_completion_tokens' instead and will reject these requests; stick to the
gpt-4.1 / gpt-4o family until that is handled in the provider.

To route cheap work to a local model: set OLLAMA_BASE_URL and add a profile
with provider 'ollama'. Give it a fallbackProfile -- if the local model cannot
call tools reliably, tool-carrying requests go somewhere that can instead of
returning prose where a tool call was needed.
